title: A lovely day trip in Jerez and Cadiz
text: We loved the Sherry tasting experience in Jerez.  We learned a lot about the sherry production process and really enjoyed tasting the different sherries.  In Cadiz we enjoyed the free time walking around the city and having lunch near the fish market.  Our tour guide Petra gave us lots of information about the history of both cities and points of interest along the way.  Great day trip!

title: A supreme end to a wonderful holiday!
text: Nothing could have prepared us for what was the most compelling and absorbing tour experience we’ve had to date. Our lovely guide Maribelle, first gave us a whistle stop tour by train of the general site; this was followed by a walking tour of the bodegas, passing between towering columns of barrels dating as far back as 300 years. The tour concluded with a sherry tasting and tapas  - we opted for the 4-sherry version, so the legs were slightly more wobbly afterwards. Finishing off the trip, we popped into the rather wonderful Tio Pepe gift shop and walked away with a rather fine bottle of Lep
author: David M

title: Great!

author: darlenehL4474XF

title: Manuel is an excellent guide and host
text: Thoroughly enjoyed the trip to the sherry producer in Jerez and onwards to Cadiz with Manuel.  He has extensive knowledge of the region and a comfortable and interesting way of sharing the information with his group.  He is friendly and was able to involve all participants which created an even more enjoyable experience. The visit to Cadiz was amazing, and would not have been nearly so interesting without Manuel’s tour and information.  Our driver was excellent and our trip was comfortable and safe.  Highly recommend this trip with Manuel.;
author: 83helenm

title: A fascinating and enjoyable trip
text: We had a great day out with our guide Manuel.  He was warm, friendly, caring and funny.  Added to which he had a passion for history which he shared with us making the visit to these historic places even more relevant and interesting.  Thanks to him and driver Sarah we had a really enjoyable trip.
